headline: Compuage Infocom Limited: 27th CoC Meeting Outcome Intimated to NSE
sum: Compuage Infocom Limited disclosed the outcome of its 27th Committee of Creditors (CoC) meeting to NSE, continuing its Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process under the IBC.
implication: CoC meeting outcomes in CIRP are material disclosure events for creditors and equity holders; the progression from CoC meeting to formal NSE disclosure signals procedural compliance and potential movement toward resolution or liquidation.
detail: Compuage Infocom Limited, a technology company, intimated the National Stock Exchange of India Ltd about the outcomes of its 27th Committee of Creditors meeting held in August 2026 under the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process. The filing, dated 25 Aug 2026, was submitted as part of mandatory exchange disclosure obligations. The specific decision(s) taken at the 27th CoC meeting were not detailed in the public NSE filing summary available.
